documents.title: City of Bunnell announces special Commission meeting for De Novo hearing regarding Project Butterfly
documents.summary: Media release. The Commission will rehear the Project Butterfly application on Oct. 28 at 9 a.m. after appeals of the Sept. 1 Planning, Zoning and Appeals Board decision. Order: staff, applicant, appellants (20 min), appellees (20 min), rebuttal (15 min), public comment, then decision. Notices mailed to owners within 500 feet.
